server_facts_as_found.aggro: Every monster is proximity-aggressive: IDLE acquires the nearest live player within `aggro` m. No passive, assist or looter modes exist.
server_facts_as_found.chase_drop: APPROACH drops the target when it is farther than aggro x 1.5 m.
server_facts_as_found.leash: Circle around the spawn home; beyond `leash` m the monster resets to IDLE with full HP. Validation requires leash >= aggro.
server_facts_as_found.skill: One 'splash' per enemy: when the target is within 2.5 m (hard-coded) and the cooldown is 0, WINDUP locks the target point; ACTIVE moves the monster onto that point and damages every player within splash_radius. The hit lands on the first ACTIVE tick; splash_active_ms only sizes validation and presentation.
server_facts_as_found.timing_rule: windup >= 100, active > 0, recovery > 0, cooldown >= windup + active, all multiples of 50
server_facts_as_found.punish_window: Player hits on a monster in RECOVERY or STAGGER deal x1.5. Perfect guard staggers the monster for 20 ticks (1000 ms) and opens a x2 counter.
server_facts_as_found.monster_collision: None: monsters move in straight lines through water, rock and trunks.
server_facts_as_found.ids: Monster id = 101 + spawn row index. Appending rows keeps existing ids stable.
server_facts_as_found.wire_cap: MAX_MONSTERS = 64 per snapshot (apps/server/src/wire.rs), no AOI yet; HP and max_hp are u16 on the wire (<= 65535).
server_facts_as_found.stats_missing: No level, defence, race, element or size fields on enemies. Player hits ignore monster defence (there is none); monster hits subtract player DEF (minimum 1).
server_facts_as_found.clock: No day/night or weather on the server. The client clock is deterministic from room elapsed time.
server_facts_as_found.client_visuals: Every monster kind renders as the shared pink slime (actors.ts createSlime) until per-kind art lands.

clock.source: sampleEnvironment(elapsedMs): hours = (13.5 + elapsed/2700000*24) % 24; daylight = smoothstep(-0.14, 0.32, sin((hours-6)/24*2pi)); weather slot 300000 ms; rain when slot hash in [0.80, 0.95) (15 %)
clock.server_requirement: S4: port sampleEnvironment to Rust so spawn phases use the same clock the client renders.

notes: R2 is the owner rule (2 m from a path centre). R2b is the stricter design rule: homes and patrols stay 1.5 m off the path edge.

R7 (edge-based): every aggressive (and night-aggressive) home and patrol sample sits at least path half-width + aggro from every path centreline, so the aggro disc never overlaps a path surface: a player on a path is never aggroed. R7s applies the same test to pseudo-passive types with their step-0 interim radius (3.0 m, owner decision 2).

R6 gate apron = the city arrival ramps and canal outflow from content/source/zones.json city_traversal (layout hazard city_canal_water_0 x +-6.4 z 16..60, ramps x +-6.8..13.3 z 8..24). No homes there. Both gate roads start on this apron at the exit ramps (-10,15) and (10,15).

R5 boss: Galehorn's home and every patrol sample sit on the layout windstone_altar (within its radius_m of its centre), and its body stays inside the windstone_circle ring (distance to the circle centre + body_radius + R5_boss_ring_margin_m <= radius_m). The arena is the layout boss_arena_radius_m around the circle centre. Circle, altar and arena are read from the layout, never copied.

R9 first-clearing leash polygons stay 1 m off the surface of every R9_first_clearing_sanctuary_paths path (both gate roads and the camp spur): a provoked monster gives up at the road (newbie sanctuary).

server_extensions.name: Spawn zones
server_extensions.what: Row field `zone`; zones carry spawn and leash polygons. Leash = leaving the polygon -> evade home at 1.5x speed with full heal; targets are acquired only inside the polygon; 3 s re-aggro immunity after evade. Respawn at a random valid point within 2 m of home. Optional patrol polylines (loop or ping-pong, pause, speed multiplier).

server_extensions.name: Aggro modes
server_extensions.what: passive (only after damage), aggressive (radius), assist (same-link monsters within radius join when one is damaged), looter (picks up stale/unwatched drops, re-drops them to the original owner on death), alert pause before the first approach, sleeping state at night (aggro x0.5).

server_extensions.name: Second skill and shapes
server_extensions.what: Optional second skill per enemy with its own timings and trigger range (today fixed at 2.5 m); shapes circle_self, cone, lane, ring_donut; knockback.
server_extensions.why: skill 2 for every monster; boss and elite telegraph variety

server_extensions.name: Server clock and weather
server_extensions.what: Port sampleEnvironment to Rust; rows gain `phases` (day/twilight/night/rain) and optional `night_home`; at a phase change idle monsters fade out and reappear at their phase home.
server_extensions.why: day/night and rain variants agree with what players see

server_extensions.name: Elite and boss rules
server_extensions.what: Respawn windows with jitter and a daylight gate; 60 s zone announcement; contribution-based personal loot and EXP split; arena reset after 10 s with no contributor inside; contribution survives 120 s reconnects; stagger cap; phase triggers by HP. Gale Seed offering at the windstone_altar (owner decision 3): wakes Galehorn once per character, only while it is not alive and at least 30 min after its last death; consumes the seed (refused offerings keep it); per-character 'woke Galehorn' flag stored server-side.
server_extensions.why: fair MVP-like events without last-hit stealing (catalog SYS-09); the three_windmarks reward (gale_seed) gets a purpose

server_extensions.name: Level and defence
server_extensions.what: Enemy fields `level` and `def` (flat, like player DEF); race/element/size stored and shown on the nameplate; no modifiers until SYS-04.
server_extensions.why: RO-style identity and future card/element systems

server_extensions.name: Monster collision
server_extensions.what: Monsters move with the planar capsule against static colliders and trunks; stuck for 1 s -> evade.
server_extensions.why: no visible clipping through trunks and rocks during chases

migration.rule: Rows 0-12 keep their index and enemy id (monster ids 101-113 unchanged); only x/z change. New rows are appended in deploy-step order so earlier ids never shift.

owner_decisions.note: The owner said 'do best choice'; these are the recorded choices.

decisions.decision: The first clearing (hunt_meadow_west / hunt_meadow_east) is passive-only: puddlekin, mosslings and day wisps; boar rows 6 and 7 live in the falls meadow.
Interim passive = a 3 m aggro radius (puddlekin, mossling and glade_wisp step0 aggro 3.0) until server passive mode (S2) lands.
decisions.consequence: glade_wisp step0 aggro 3.5 -> 3.0; R7s uses 3.0 m for all three

decisions.decision: A Gale Seed offered at the altar wakes Galehorn: once per character, only when the boss is not alive and at least 30 min have passed since its last death. The seed is consumed.
The proposed drop chances are accepted (drop status 'accepted'), tunable after an economy review.

open_questions: Owner idea, future system: a hunters' bounty board at the camp for elite and boss kills.
Layout: the 4 ring stones other than the gate stones (+-6.4,-63) have no positions yet; once placed, add them to the prop clearance check (Galehorn's patrol keeps its body 0.65 m inside the ring).
